integration_findings: Native movers/camera outputs, animation/IK authored outputs and audio flags publish via native data journals. Physics publishes through the shared lower-level scene pose preparation/atomic publication boundary without a reverse core dependency.

Per-producer/per-pass atomic output is distinct from runtime progression: animation clocks/events, solver bodies/contacts and audio voices/clocks remain subsystem-owned. Native data-only commits reject runtime effects.
Unified Transform validity across scene, component and gameplay entry points; parent-first pose conversion validates singular/cyclic ancestry; unchanged poses do not become dirty.
